title: batest testSet.json (v2)
description: Primary, authoritative description of a .batest test set, as described in SPEC.md.

testSetId.description: Stable, immutable test-set identifier (UUIDv7). MUST NOT change once assigned, per SPEC.md 'Identifier Stability'.

creatorUuid.description: Optional creator identifier. Always present; null when not set.

description.description: Optional free-text description. Omitted entirely when unset.

comparisonCategory.$comment: Raw category value (e.g. 'microphones', 'others'). TODO: full COMPARISON_CATEGORIES enum not given in source spec.

comparisonCategoryOther.description: Free-text value when comparisonCategory is 'others'. Omitted otherwise.

comparisonSubcategory.description: Only relevant for categories with subcategories (currently only 'effects'). Omitted otherwise.

comparisonSubcategoryOther.description: Free-text value when comparisonSubcategory is 'others'. Omitted otherwise.

playback.description: Reserved for future fields; no fields defined yet. Omitted entirely when empty.

randomization.description: Reserved for future fields; no fields defined yet. Omitted entirely when empty.

resources.description: External references not embedded in the container. Omitted entirely when empty.

type.$comment: Open-ended; e.g. 'link', 'paper'. Not an exhaustive enum in the source spec.

test.description: One or more test objects making up the test set.

testId.description: Zero-based index of this test object within the test array. MUST correspond to its position in test (first object is 0, second is 1, ...) and MUST be unique within the test set.

testType.description: This test object's test type. MUST match testTypeConfig's single key on the same object.

title.description: Optional display title for this individual test within the test set, independent of testSet.json's root-level title. Omitted entirely when not set (v2.1+).

soundSource.description: Optional raw sound-source-category value for this individual test (e.g. 'vocals', 'other'), scoped per test object rather than per test set. Omitted entirely when not set. New in v2.2.

soundSourceOther.description: Free-text value when the sentinel 'other' (singular — not 'others') was selected for soundSource. Omitted otherwise. New in v2.2.

soundSourceSubtype.description: Optional, more specific classification within soundSource. Omitted both when soundSource has no subtypes and when it does but none was selected. New in v2.2.

soundSourceSubtypeOther.description: Free-text value when the sentinel 'other' was selected for soundSourceSubtype, independent of soundSource's own sentinel. Omitted otherwise. New in v2.2.

backingTrack.description: Always present; null when this test does not use a backing track.

loudnessMatching.description: Omitted entirely when loudness matching was not enabled for this test.

mode.$comment: Currently the only defined value is 'integrated-lufs'.

reference.$comment: Currently the only defined value is 'loudest'.

trackLengthMode.description: Omitted when all of this test's tracks have the same length, or there is only one track. Never present when testType is 'rating'.

content.description: What is being compared. Optional at testSet root, test-object level, and track level. Omitted entirely when there is nothing to add. Track overrides test overrides testSet root, per field.

type.description: Free-text or open-vocabulary label for the source material, e.g. 'vocals', 'acoustic-guitar', 'full-mix'.

recording.description: Recording setup context. Optional at test-object level and track level only (not testSet root). Omitted entirely when there is nothing to add. Track overrides test, per field.

oneOf.description: Free-form object describing the space. All sub-fields optional.
Free-form object describing the instrument or voice being recorded.

signalChain.description: Ordered recording chain shared by all tracks (test level) or the track-specific delta (track level).

type.$comment: e.g. 'microphone', 'preamp', 'converter', 'cable', 'other'. Not an exhaustive enum in the source spec.

assets.description: Optional at testSet root and test-object level (not track level). Omitted entirely when neither cover nor items has content. Only the sub-field(s) with actual content are present.

cover.description: Path to the test set's preview image. Omitted when no cover image is set.

trackId.description: Zero-based index of the track within its parent test object's tracks array. MUST correspond to the track's position in that tracks array (first track is 0, second is 1, ...) and MUST be unique within that test object's tracks array.

filename.description: Technical, sequentially generated name the file is stored under in required/. Authoritative for locating the file.

originalFilename.description: Name of the file as originally uploaded by the user. Display purposes only.

label.description: Optional display name for the track. Always present; null when not set.

notes.description: Optional free-text note. Omitted entirely when unset.

originalFormat.$comment: TODO: exact string tokens for aac/m4a/ogg-vorbis are not given as examples in the source spec. Confirmed values: 'wav', 'aiff', 'mp3', 'flac'.

storedFormat.$comment: TODO: see originalFormat. Confirmed values: 'flac' (converted), plus the same lossy tokens as originalFormat when passed through as-is.

originalSampleRate.description: Sample rate of the originally uploaded file, in Hz.

originalBitDepth.description: Bit depth of the originally uploaded file. Always present; null for lossy-compressed formats.

integratedLufs.description: Measured integrated loudness (LUFS). Omitted entirely when loudness matching was not run for this test.

testTypeConfig.description: Exactly one key, identifying the test type. MUST match the sibling testType field.
